outcome: postpartum hemorrhage (calculated estimated blood loss >1000ml or red-cell transfusion within 2 days)
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean delivery at 34 or more gestational weeks, either before or during labor.
finding: Tranexamic acid treatment significantly reduced the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (calculated estimated blood loss >1000 ml or red-cell transfusion by day 2) compared to placebo in women undergoing cesarean delivery, though secondary clinical outcomes were not significantly different.
mod_finding: The study's findings are specific to women undergoing cesarean delivery, indicating that tranexamic acid is effective in reducing blood loss within this mode of birth.
